name: Krea 2 Art & Styles
author: various
description: Krea 2 checkpoints that do not look like Krea 2. Equinox: crisp, idealised semi-real characters. Fascium KREA ART: 99 painterly artist styles, turns everything into paint. Fwaun Tune: flat-colour, lineless semi-chibi characters. Wulver: anthro and kemono characters that stay animals. Ray Krea2 x Mid Aesthetic: moody, romantic, Midjourney-style pictures. Since 2.0.0, two dark looks from the old Krea 2 pack: BF95 Dark Realism (cool, cinematic photoreal grade) and VXP Beta 3 (backlit, high-contrast, on photos and illustration alike); the six anime cards moved to Krea 2 Anime. All render at native ~2 MP with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x) and share the Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE with the other Krea 2 packs. For photography use Krea 2 Realism or Krea 2 Finetunes.

presets.name: Equinox Krea 2 (Semi-Realistic)
presets.tagline: Crisp, idealised semi-real characters and illustration
presets.description:
Text to image with crisp, idealised semi-real characters: sharp eyes, clean shading and compositions of its own instead of stock Krea 2's. It works best on anime, fantasy and illustration prompts, and it was the most distinct of the six Krea 2 checkpoints we compared. This is the first Krea 2 release of the Equinox model, and the author calls it experimental.

It restyles photo prompts too (younger, prettier, glossier), so use a Krea 2 realism card for candid photography.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 16 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): credit required, no derivatives or merges, commercial use of images not granted.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models): Civitai model 1833737, version 3370191 'Krea2_int8_ConvRot', file 3258362, 13,149,954,464 B, SHA256 73730408f3b33d92a0ef79658adcafe7e7046bb0d17285d5f9f80fcfec889852; + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. The author gives no Krea 2 settings (the page text is for the SDXL versions), so this uses the Krea 2 Turbo convention: euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Tested 2026-10-03 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 5 prompts x 2 seeds at 1024x1536 against base Krea 2 Turbo and Realia; then 3 seeds through the app at 1216x1632 (3:4), all rendered, and Upscale 1.5 clean on the engine. Median 16 s per picture. LICENCE (Civitai): credit required, no derivatives/merges, image-commercial use not granted.

presets.name: Fascium KREA ART (Painterly)
presets.tagline: Paints everything: oil, engraving and poster styles by name
presets.description:
Text to image that paints everything: a merge of 99 artist styles covering old-master oil, Baroque, Impressionist, Art Nouveau, engraving, poster lithography and anime production art. It is painterly by design. In our test every prompt turned into paint, and even an anime schoolgirl came out as a painted illustration rather than cel anime.

Call a style by name: 'in the manner of Rembrandt', 'in the style of Gustav Klimt', 'in the manner of Alphonse Mucha', 'Piranesi style', 'in the style of J.M.W. Turner'.

SFW by design. For photographs use a Krea 2 realism card.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 21 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): commercial use, merges and derivatives allowed.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models): Civitai model 2960566, version 3371592 'v2.0', file 3259917 (int8_convrot), 13,149,020,736 B, SHA256 56f3607410a612c30e0dab15fb13a10522282ee14da9baf8ef8d14a2944e0cb9; + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. Author's settings: Euler a, 8-12 steps, CFG 1-3, 1024x1536 or 1536x1024; this card runs euler_ancestral/simple, 10 steps, CFG 1 (CFG above 1 not tested here, so no CFG slider). Tested 2026-10-03 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 5 prompts x 2 seeds at 1024x1536 against base Krea 2 Turbo and Realia; then 3 seeds through the app at 1216x1632 (3:4), all rendered, and Upscale 1.5 clean on the engine. Median 21 s per picture. An int4 build (6.9 GB) exists on the same page for low VRAM; not tested. LICENCE (Civitai): commercial use, merges and derivatives allowed.

presets.name: Fwaun Tune Krea 2 (Semi-Chibi)
presets.tagline: Flat colour, no line art, big-headed characters
presets.description:
Text to image in one look: flat colour, no outlines, and softly deformed, big-headed characters. The style is strong. In our test it redrew every prompt this way, including a photo prompt and a Rembrandt oil painting.

The card adds the trigger 'semi-chibi style.' in front of your prompt for you. The author's other triggers also work when you type them: 'monochrome', and 'photorealistic background' for a flat character over a photo-like scene.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 18 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): commercial use of images allowed, derivatives allowed.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models): Civitai model 2846802 (Fwaun Tune), version 3220385 'krea2_turbo_v5.0', file 3102474 (int8 + ConvRot), 13,963,603,120 B, SHA256 1d21e6a6489b4f3580f4f1d9e4682c63df075244fce5f1c0779dc67881146bf4. Note the model page's NEWEST version is for Qwen-Image 2.1; this card pins the Krea 2 one. + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. No settings published for the Krea 2 build; uses euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed. The workflow prepends 'semi-chibi style. ' to the prompt, and the card blanks the app's default quality suffix (image.values.quality): with 'high quality, detailed, sharp focus' the background turned photoreal on 3 of 3. Tested 2026-10-03 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 5 prompts x 2 seeds at 1024x1536 against base Krea 2 Turbo and Realia; then 3 seeds through the app at 1216x1632 (3:4), all rendered, and Upscale 1.5 clean on the engine. Median 18 s per picture. 'monochrome' and 'photorealistic background' triggers are the author's and were not tested here. LICENCE (Civitai): image-commercial use allowed, derivatives allowed.

presets.name: Wulver Krea 2 (Anthro)
presets.tagline: Anthro and kemono characters that stay animals
presets.description:
Text to image for anthro, furry and kemono characters that stay animals. In our test stock Krea 2 drew a small anime cat-wolf, while this drew a real wolf-headed character with a muzzle, fur and paws every time. It is a full fine-tune of Krea 2, not a merge.

Prompt in prose (60-120 words, and describe the background) or in booru/e621 tags. The card puts the rating tag 'sfw,' in front of your prompt, as the model expects.

It also knows 1,113 artist tokens (@name, typed first; the list is on the model's Hugging Face page). There are two catches, and we saw them on every render: a token can write the artist's name on the picture as a signature, and the character can lose clothing you asked for. Even without a token, a faint signature scribble sometimes appears in a corner. The author also reports a smeared top or bottom edge on some pictures.

There is no CFG slider because higher CFG burns the picture.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass.

Licence: Krea 2 Community License (see the Hugging Face repo). The Civitai page asks for credit.

Author's settings: euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1.0, trained to 1024 px; rating tag first, then an optional @artist token. The workflow prepends 'sfw, '. Tested 2026-10-03 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 6 prompts x 3 seeds at 1024x1024 against base Krea 2 Turbo, then 3 seeds through the app at 1216x1632 (coherent above its 1024 training size). The card blanks the app's default quality suffix (image.values.quality), which otherwise gives a glossier rendered look. Artist tokens @kenket, @blotch, @honovy: subtle style shift, artist name written on the picture 6 of 6 for two of them, shorts dropped 9 of 9. Author's known issue: some pictures have a smeared top or bottom edge. LICENCE: Krea 2 Community License (see the Hugging Face repo); Civitai page asks for credit.

presets.name: Ray Krea2 x Mid Aesthetic
presets.description:
Moody, romantic pictures with a Midjourney and Niji feel: rich, dark colour, cinematic framing and a touch of gothic melancholy. It works across portraits, landscapes, sci-fi and anime, and keeps the same polished look on all of them.

Ray3780 built it on Krea 2 Turbo from a blend of @OnlyLemon's LoRAs, which were trained on her own artwork. In our test it often framed people closer than the prompt asked and sometimes made them younger and more glamorous (a woman in her thirties came out about twenty), so describe age and framing clearly if they matter. Anime prompts come out as painted, semi-real illustration.

Write plain sentences. Krea 2 ignores negative prompts at CFG 1.

This card uses the author's ER SDE at 12 steps and CFG 1, about 42 seconds a picture at 2 MP on a 12 GB card. The author suggests 8 to 12 steps. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass.

requirements.notes: Krea 2 DiT (diffusion_models) + Qwen3VL 4B fp8 encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. CFG 1, negative zeroed. Upscale >1 adds the 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass gated off at Upscale 1, as on the other Krea 2 cards. Krea 2 Turbo fine-tune, INT8 ConvRot (diffusion_models, 12.82 GB, sha256 554b9d48b93c7d4db698ba7f35cee3dc79e34b521557cbfea1f03ddbe84bd999, Civitai model 3009760 / version 3415465 'turbo v1 INT8ConvRot' / fileId 3308391, by Ray3780, published 2026-10-19; the only file). Author: er_sde / simple, 8-12 steps, CFG 1; the author's sample PNGs read 10-12 steps er_sde simple with a Wan 2.1 VAE (the same architecture as the Qwen-Image VAE the card uses) and abliterated Qwen3-VL encoders. Bake: on the 'woman in her thirties' photo prompt both seeds came out about twenty and glamorous; tighter framing than base Turbo on photo and gothic prompts. Baked 2026-11-06 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine, ComfyUI 0.44.0, direct submission) at 1024x1536 on 5 prompts x 2 seeds against Krea 2 Turbo, duplicate control pixel-identical (F:\Claude-Work\checkpoint-request-20261106). Engine-direct median 24.8 s. Verified in the app 2026-11-06 (engine v0.44.0): photo on 2 seeds at 3:4 (1216x1632), a lettered poster at 1:1 (spelled right), anime at 16:9, a portrait at 2:3 (a woman in her fifties kept her age) and Upscale 1.5 at 1:1, all clean; settings read back from engine history; median 42.4 s per picture through the app, 71.6 s at Upscale 1.5.

presets.name: BF95 Krea 2 Dark Realism v3.0
presets.description:
Dark, cinematic photoreal pictures with a cool grade, clean skin and strong background separation. A mix of Realism Engine, Ideogram 4 and Krea 2.

It renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail pass that came out clean at 1.5x; 1x is a clean single pass.

About 28 seconds for a 1408 px picture on a 12 GB card, and Upscale 1.5 adds about 6 seconds. 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes about 3 times longer.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, scaled-fp8) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Dark cinematic realism mix (Realism Engine + Ideogram 4 + Krea 2). Renders at ~2 MP natively (Krea 2 supports 1K-2K); 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes ~3x longer. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass, as in the official Krea 2 Turbo preset; at Upscale 1 the refine is bypassed by a core ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode gate, because a same-size refine pass blotches skin on these mixes (tested 4 sampler/denoise variants, all bad; 1.5x is clean). Measured 2026-09-01: 1408x1408 in ~28 s on a 4070 Ti; Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~6 s. All six presets were verified at Upscale 1 and 1.5 with the gate in place.

presets.name: VXP Krea 2 Beta 3 (Hybrid)
presets.tagline: The same dark, backlit look on photos and illustration
presets.description:
The same dark, backlit, high-contrast look as Beta 4, but it covers anime, semi-real and realistic from one checkpoint. This is a separate branch of the experimental beta series, not an older Beta 4.

On anime and semi-real prompts the two are close. The difference is photographs: Beta 3 keeps them photographic (moody window light, real skin texture) where Beta 4 turns them into illustration.

Uncensored.

About 14 seconds a picture at 1 MP on a 12 GB card, and 24-26 seconds at 1216x1632. Upscale above 1 and LoRAs are untested on this card.

Licence (Civitai): credit not required, no derivatives or merges, commercial use limited to generation services.
